verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party pricing or plan documentation showing predictable costs or protection against per-request cliffs as records and queries grow. Community reports point the other way: users describe the price-per-search model as costly for live-search UIs, large indexes as too expensive at scale, and replica indexes for each sort order multiplying record counts against limits.

support.subject: As a founder, costs stay predictable as records and query volume grow — no surprise per-request cliffs
